class.name: WorldStreaming
class.brief_description: Shared infrastructure for streaming world content.
class.description: [WorldStreaming] is the singleton used by the systems that stream world content, such as [Landscape3D]: - a prioritized job queue executed by dedicated streaming threads (see [member ProjectSettings.streaming/threads/thread_count]), whose results are applied on the main thread, - the registry of streaming sources ([StreamingSource3D]), - named memory pools with budgets, also exposed as performance monitors (Debugger > Monitors > Streaming).

method.name: get_pool_limit
method.description: Returns the budget of a memory pool in bytes ([code]0[/code] if unlimited).

method.name: get_pool_names
method.description: Returns the names of the memory pools, e.g. Landscape CPU and Landscape GPU.

method.name: get_pool_usage
method.description: Returns the memory used by a pool, in bytes.

method.name: get_queued_job_count
method.description: Returns the number of jobs waiting for a streaming thread.

method.name: get_running_job_count
method.description: Returns the number of jobs being executed.

method.name: get_source_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered streaming sources.

method.name: get_thread_count
method.description: Returns the number of streaming threads.

method.name: is_pool_over_limit
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the usage of the pool exceeds its budget.

method.name: process
method.description: Applies the results of the finished jobs. This is done automatically every frame.

method.name: set_pool_limit
method.description: Sets the budget of a memory pool in bytes ([code]0[/code] for unlimited).
